cells.text: Very Light Trajectory | Strong Ally Homing Applies Cure x1 to the user and allies within 7.5 metres of impact, and creates a Restoration Orb that lasts 7.5 seconds. Restoration Orb applies Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds upon being picked up. Orb has a 7.5 meter pickup radius, and 100 HP.
Applies Cure ↑x2 to user and allies. Restoration Orb applies ↑x2 Restoration for 4+2 seconds.

Enhances certain Grenade types: Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds. Firebolt Grenades seek radius is increased by 50% to 12 meters and target up to 5 enemies. Solar Grenades linger for 2 seconds longer and release Magma Orbs that deal 125 [50] damage each. Magma Orbs do not have damage falloff. Fusion Grenades explode again after 0.5 seconds, dealing up to 851 [50] damage in a 8 metre radius.

clarity.coverage: Touch of Flame 83039193; no standalone Healing Grenade named entry exists in this pinned file.

official.supports: Historical introduction: allied tracking; impact Cure; a separate blessing grants Restoration on pickup. Does not establish current cooldown, exact projectile parameters or multi-recipient pickup policy.

implementation_dependency.requirement: A damageable finite-lifetime Restoration Orb must be consumed through a confirmed world write before dependent rewards; consumption is not damage or death.
implementation_dependency.engine_action: chorus:consume_construct with an exact entity life anchor, current-runtime ownership and explicit outcomes.
implementation_dependency.not_claimed: The consumption action is not a Healing Grenade implementation or an automatically qualified pickup.

uncertainties: Strong ally homing and very light trajectory do not supply speed, gravity, drag, acquisition cone/range or turn rate.
Orb size, spawn offset relative to impact, HP projection, collector eligibility, simultaneous or per-player pickup and post-pickup lifetime need explicit calibration/policy.
Source gives 119.7s base cooldown, 0.875 chunk scalar, 7.5m Cure/collection radius, 7.5s orb life and 100 HP; this is not independent live-game measurement.

policies: Capture Touch of Flame strength at accepted cast. Query each actual recipient for Solace when the orb is consumed. Accepted flight/orb survives selection/source changes.
Cure uses a 7.5m sphere around the historical contact, querying allied feet without line of sight. Caster receives Cure only when within that sphere.

Offset the captured contact along its surface normal by body half extent plus clearance, then subtract half height to convert body center to native feet. Entity contacts have zero normal and center the body at contact.

The first qualifying scheduled scan consumes one shared orb before granting Restoration to its captured allied batch; later arrivals get nothing. This multiplayer policy is not confirmed by the cited sources.
Collection uses current allied feet in a 7.5m sphere centered on current same-life orb body, includes the caster, excludes the orb, and uses identity ordering without line of sight.
Missing/dead orb life removes behavior; source-owner relation unavailable yields no collection and waits until a later successful scan or expiry. Same-life death/removal cancels behavior.
Known recipient denial/shared Cure cooldown does not refund the throw or claim. Rejected orb spawn retains already accepted Cure. Unknown world results stop without replaying committed writes.
Touch of Flame is supplied by a typed source tag; full Aspect production selection and its other grenade branches are not implemented by this definition.
limits: All movement, homing, body dimensions/clearance, health projection and scan phase values are explicit synthetic calibration, not measured Destiny physics.
Reference definitions remain in acceptance resources; full production subclass/Aspect wiring, renderer/HUD, native cross-restart restoration and all exotic/mod combinations remain incomplete.
